question: Who captained India to victory in the 2011 Cricket World Cup final win over Sri Lanka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahendra Singh Dhoni**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni** captained India to victory in the 2011 Cricket World Cup final against Sri Lanka.
 
• The final match was held at the Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai on April 2, 2011.
 
• India won the match by six wickets, chasing down Sri Lanka's target of 275 runs.
 
• Dhoni played a crucial role in the victory, scoring an unbeaten 91 runs and hitting the winning six.
 
• This victory marked India's second Cricket World Cup win, the first being in 1983.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mahendra Singh Dhoni**, commonly known as MS Dhoni, is one of the most successful captains in Indian cricket history.
 
• Under his captaincy, India also won the ICC T20 World Cup in 2007 and the ICC Champions Trophy in 2013.
 
• Dhoni is known for his calm demeanor, strategic acumen, and finishing abilities in high-pressure situations.
 
• He received numerous accolades for his captaincy and contributions to Indian cricket, including the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards.
 
• Dhoni announced his retirement from international cricket on August 15, 2020.
